statement: You are given an integer array asteroids describing asteroids in a row. The absolute value of each entry is the asteroid's size and the sign is its direction: positive moves right, negative moves left. All asteroids move at the same speed.

Two asteroids collide only when a right-moving one is to the left of a left-moving one. In a collision the smaller asteroid explodes; if both are the same size, both explode. Asteroids moving in the same direction never meet.
Return the asteroids that are left after all collisions, in their original left-to-right order.

examples.explanation: −5 destroys 2, then meets 10 and is destroyed itself.
The two asteroids are the same size, so both explode.
−3 destroys 2 and then 1. After that only left-moving asteroids are to its left, so it survives. 4 moves right, away from everything.
